findings.what: The new HUD units declare gPlayerRank as char[], while inventory still declares the same named object as a scalar char. These are incompatible extern types despite identical byte accesses. This is separate from the explicitly deferred entity/present record consolidation. No binary mismatch was observed. Legacy VBLANK_FLAG_2 signedness and P1_MENU_OPEN scalar/array inconsistencies also prevent a claim of complete cross-src interface consistency.
findings.suggested_fix: Use char gPlayerRank[] in inventory and gPlayerRank[0] at its first-player lookup, preserving the distinct canonical gPlayer2Rank name. Private recommended/inventory.c demonstrates all 37 functions MATCH both revisions. Carry the already-existing flag/menu inconsistencies explicitly into interface reconciliation rather than calling the current declarations globally consistent.

findings.what: The redundant (&gPlayerInfo[index])->member spelling materially steers MCC68K: ordinary direct member access emits indexed compares and is four bytes shorter; pointer-addition and cached-pointer alternatives also miss. The current source has no local disclosure of this compiler-sensitive choice. Conversely, the explicit short cast on displayed_health / 8 is unnecessary: removing it preserves both complete functions byte-for-byte in both revisions. Historical spelling/intent is [INFERENCE].
findings.suggested_fix: Record the address-of/index expression as a source qualification with the observed ADDA.W-versus-indexed-compare evidence, not as proved historical source. Remove the redundant division-result cast; alternatives/no_narrowing/hud_health_update.c MATCHes both functions in both revisions. No executable behavior repair is requested.

findings.what: HealthAndLivesChecks calls its second argument promotion_flags, but the sole original-ROM caller ProcessPlayers derives it from LAND_UNDER_TOEJAM / LAND_UNDER_EARL masked by 0xf0, then supplies it to many player-state routines. This function forwards that value unchanged to PerformPromotion; there is no evidence that it is a set of promotion-specific flags. The callee treats its third argument as an unsigned class/threshold value for other modes, and mode 11 skips that test.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the argument to terrain_class (or a similarly neutral land-value name) and briefly state the observed caller origin; exact historical/gameplay terminology remains [INFERENCE]. Private recommended/hud_status.c performs only the rename and MATCHes all eight functions, including literal data, in both revisions.

qualification_summary: No blocking byte mismatch, false revision-table extent, missing assigned C009 fix, or prohibited matching device was found. Both normal ROMs reproduce exactly and both negative controls fail correctly. Acceptance remains qualified by the new rank extern mismatch, an undisclosed compiler-sensitive address-of/index spelling with one removable cast, and an over-specific parameter name, plus expressly acknowledged pre-existing/shared-header debt. Suggested candidates were matched privately, not adopted or claimed as new full-build inputs.
